title: Resend Geek Command via Aveva API using command GUID after Geek+ callback/send error
summary: Use the Aveva API interface’s “Resend Geek Command” to resend a previously sent Geek+ command by entering the command GUID when the original send/callback encountered an error (including after Geek+ server restart).
when_to_use: When a Geek+ command was sent but encountered an error, or when Geek+ server restart occurred and callbacks need to be retried; once Geek+ is up, resend the command using the command GUID.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for required physical safety actions during a restart scenario; follow the source’s safety guidance (E-stop before restart) if applicable.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Aveva API “Resend Geek Command” action by providing the correct command GUID and verifying the response indicates acceptance/success.
safety_notes: The source notes that in the event of a restart, users should E-stop the system before doing a restart.
access_or_tools_needed: Aveva API interface/page that includes “Resend Geek Command”

access_required: Access to the Aveva API interface/page that exposes the Geek+ RMS command set (includes “Resend Geek Command”).
system_preconditions: Geek+ is up (the source states that once Geek+ is up, you can specify the command GUID and it will resend the command).

visual_references.description: Aveva API page showing Geek+ RMS recovery commands including “Resend Geek Command”.

steps.title: Submit/execute the resend command
steps.purpose: Trigger the resend operation using the provided command GUID.
steps.instruction: Submit/execute the “Resend Geek Command” action using the entered command GUID.

steps.failure_condition: The resend request cannot be submitted or does not start processing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Once Geek Plus is up, you can specify the command GUID and it will resend the command to Geek Plus.

steps.title: Confirm the resend request is accepted (success confirmation or error message)
steps.purpose: Verify the resend attempt was accepted and identify errors if it was not.

steps.healthy_condition: The UI indicates the resend request was accepted successfully (no error message for the resend action).
steps.failure_condition: An error message is returned for the resend action, or no acceptance/success indication appears.

actions.exact_action: Confirm the resend request is accepted (e.g., success confirmation or absence of an error message).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the resend fails or returns an error, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Resend Geek Command ... Allows users to specify a command GUID that was sent to Geek but encountered an error.

So if you restart Geek Plus server, we retry to send callbacks every so often ... eventually if they don't respond then we stop sending it. So once Geek Plus is up, you can specify the command GUID and it will resend the command to Geek Plus.

success_criteria: The Aveva API “Resend Geek Command” action returns a success/acceptance indication for the provided command GUID.
healthy_conditions: Geek+ is up and the resend action results in acceptance (no error message for the resend action).
failure_conditions: The resend action returns an error message.
The resend action cannot be executed or does not produce an acceptance/success indication.
escalation_guidance: If the resend fails or returns an error, stop and escalate to support.
